Author: EMCO
Name: EMCO Command Deck
Description: One dashboard for all your characters and accounts: free companies with buffs, supplies and house eligibility, houses with visit tracking and one-click teleport, the housing lottery calendar, submarine and airship timers, retainer ventures, gil and seals, your Garden Manager plants, and a Ready Now / Upcoming timeline. Imports your other characters from AutoRetainer.
Punchline: Every character, FC, house, retainer and voyage at a glance.
